explicacion: Fetches the original Restream recording again, without recompressing. Your clips are kept; afterwards, re-process them so they come out at the original's quality. Restream only keeps recordings for a limited time.
lista: Done: the episode now uses the original. Re-process the clips to take advantage of it.

confirmar.detalle: The episode's video will be replaced with the original Restream recording. Clips are kept with the same timings; you'll need to re-process them afterwards.
